decision.early_stop_reason: Even source-specific variance fields and ideal reverse waterfilling do not satisfy the same-rate promotion gate after matched-Gaussian calibration.
decision.hard_gate: charged F <= 0.8 and matched-Gaussian s >= 0.16096404744368115 at physical R in [2.15,2.5], with cold expert read <2x

overlap_boundaries.claim_boundary: A kill rejects the tested separable, low-rank-log, low-frequency DCT, and Haar variance allocation models. It is not a lower bound for arbitrary nonlinear or activation-aware codecs.
overlap_boundaries.conditional_hyperprior: That audit entropy-coded short 2048-value tile-scale residuals and measured held-out Gaussian NLL gain. This oracle instead tests source-leaky long-range 2-D variance geometry and ideal same-rate MSE reverse waterfilling. The full tile ceiling overlaps only as a deliberately favorable stop bound.
overlap_boundaries.nanoquant_binary_factor: NanoQuant used free iterative row/column equilibration before an SVD-tail or discrete binary-factor test. Here row/column scales are themselves the variance source for rate allocation; no low-rank weight reconstruction or binary factor is credited.

physical_ledger.coefficient_bits: total physical budget minus every charged side bit
physical_ledger.cold_read_definition: maximum private expert bits divided by one-sixth of total artifact bits; rate allocation is derived from the global water level

protocol.distortion_model: independent Gaussian components with fitted variances, ideal continuous reverse waterfilling

lowrank_log.fit: source-specific SVD of the 48x64 log tile-energy map

field_families.rowcol_separable: exact outer product of source row and column centered-energy marginals
field_families.rowcol_tile_ipf: source-specific multiplicative maximum-entropy field matching all row, column, and 16x32 tile energy marginals

matched_gaussian.identical_path: same source-leaky field fit, candidate grid, reverse waterfill, side charge, and selection
matched_gaussian.moment_match: exact zero mean and per-representation-matrix centered FP64 energy

protocol.matrix_coverage: all 18 pinned BF16 matrices, no sampling
protocol.source_leakage: Every field and KLT angle is fitted on the scored source. Free-side rows are intentionally impossible favorable ceilings.
